measurement: Raw Xenium transcript counts per segmented cell; sections pooled within donor, then donors weighted equally.
detection: At least one measured transcript in a segmented cell. Low counts can include background; detection does not establish functional activity.
broadRule: At least 20 regions represented by ≥2 donors and ≥100 cells; CV ≤0.30; 10th-percentile mean ≥50% of the 90th-percentile mean; ≥1% positive cells in ≥90% of evaluated regions.
peakRule: Highest donor-balanced mean among regions with ≥2 donors and ≥100 cells, peak ≥0.05 counts/cell. Areas within 80% of peak are highlighted together. Descriptive, not a statistical enrichment test.
scope: Prenatal forebrain only. Uniform expression in the entire brain cannot be inferred. Adult cortex and deep surfaces provide approximate anatomical orientation, not a prenatal reconstruction or spatial registration.
